overview.rankFilter: Emerald+ (OP.GG, patch 26.19). Lolalytics 53.41% WR / 1.42% PR / 1.88% BR (ban rate from Lolalytics); Skill Capped 51.9% / 1.5% / 2.3%; Mobalytics 51.7% / 1.4%. Warwick is mostly a jungler; top is a low-pick off-meta lane.
overview.playstyle: You are a sustain bruiser who wins by staying in fights. Your passive heals hugely below 50% and even more below 25% health, so keep committing at low HP. Trade with Q (heal) and W, fear with E, and use R as a long suppress to catch or dive one target. Pick fights when you have the Q heal up, then scale into an on-hit, tanky duelist with Blade of The Ruined King and Stridebreaker.

seasonNotes: 26.9 (last Warwick change): passive Eternal Hunger on-hit damage raised to 6-55 (was 6-46) by level. No Warwick changes in 26.10-26.19.
26.19: Emerald+ top Warwick sits around 52% win rate at ~1.4% pick rate: strong but rarely picked, so many opponents do not know the matchup.

26.1: Role Quests. Your top quest (1200 pts) completes around 12-14 min and gives bonus XP, +11% XP, level cap 20 and a free Unleashed Teleport (390 s cooldown as of 26.19), so Flash + Barrier or Flash + Ignite are both fine.
26.9: Doran's Bow and Doran's Helm added as starters; Gluttonous Greaves added. Sundered Sky nerfed in 26.16/26.17 (not part of the Warwick build).
26.16: Sterak's Gage bonus AD raised to 50% base AD, making it a stronger defensive pick for you.
26.1: Minions spawn 0:30, Baron back at 20:00, Atakhan removed, melee champions deal 20% more damage to turrets.

abilities.name: Eternal Hunger
abilities.summary: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage (6-55 by level, plus 15% bonus AD and 10% AP) and heal you for 100% of it below 50% health, and 250% below 25% health.
tips: Keep auto-attacking at low HP: below 25% your heal is at its largest, so do not back off if you are winning the trade.
Auto minions while low to heal back up between trades.
On-hit items (Blade of The Ruined King) multiply this heal.

abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
abilities.summary: Lunge at an enemy and bite for magic damage (6-10% of their max health plus AD) and heal for 25-75% of the damage dealt. Hold Q to charge and leap behind the target with displacement immunity. Costs 80-100 mana.
tips: Hold Q to close distance, tap it for a quick heal trade on a nearby target.
Use Q to catch a target that steps back after using a spell.
Save Q to reach a fleeing enemy or heal in a long fight; the cooldown is short (8 to 6 s).

abilities.name: Blood Hunt
abilities.summary: Passive: bonus attack speed, vision and move speed toward enemy champions below 50% health (doubled below 25%). Active: mark the nearest enemy champion for 8 s so you get those bonuses on them at any health. Cooldown 40-80 s.
tips: Cast W to mark the nearest enemy and get attack speed and move speed on him even at full health.
Use it to chase a low-health enemy across the map: you get move speed while following the trail.
You max Q or W first (both are fine); W first is Skill Capped, Q first is OP.GG.

abilities.name: Primal Howl
abilities.summary: Take 35-55% less damage for up to 2.75 s. Recast after 1 s (or let it end) to howl: nearby enemies are feared for 1 s and slowed. Cooldown 11-15 s.
tips: Pop E at the start of an all-in to take less damage, then let it run out to fear.
Use it as a defensive tool when a burst combo is coming.
Keep E up for the fear in teamfights so you can save or peel.

abilities.name: Infinite Duress
abilities.summary: Leap in a direction (range scales with your move speed) and suppress the first enemy champion hit for up to 1.5 s, dealing 175-525 magic damage plus bonus AD and healing for 100% of it. Cooldown 70-110 s.
tips: Aim R at a squishy or a high-priority target; it channels, so make sure no stun can cancel it.
You can use R to close a huge gap and finish a low enemy the moment you reach level 6.
Combine with E (fear) and Q to chain crowd control on one target.

combos.name: Short trade
combos.when: You are at full HP and want to heal off a Q while the enemy walks up for a minion.

combos.name: Standard all-in
combos.input: W > Q > E > AA > AA > E recast (fear)
combos.when: Level 3 and up, the enemy is below about 60% health or has used their key ability.

combos.name: Level 6 kill
combos.when: Opponent is low and cannot escape; R suppress plus Q heal finishes the fight.

combos.name: Teamfight dive
combos.input: R on the backline target > AA > Q > E on landing
combos.when: Late game with your team ready to fight: pick out a carry and survive with the heal.

combos.name: Escape or chase low target
combos.input: W (follow the trail) > Q on arrival
combos.when: A wounded enemy runs off; follow the Blood Hunt trail to catch them.

runes.name: Lethal Tempo + Resolve (default)
runes.when: Default into most matchups (92.8% of games on OP.GG, 52.2% WR; page 52.16% WR over 15,156 games). Legend: Haste, Bloodline or Coup de Grace are alternative 2nd/3rd picks.

runes.name: Press the Attack + Resolve (vs ranged / short trades)
runes.when: Vs ranged or kiting tops where you only get short windows to hit hard (Press the Attack and Fleet Footwork listed on Skill Capped; Lolalytics lists Press the Attack). Rates not available. Lolalytics 16.19 lists Press the Attack as its keystone.

summoners.when: Default (Lolalytics and Skill Capped): survive burst, then win the low-HP fight with your passive heal.
Winnable melee lanes where you want to threaten a kill; the quest gives you Teleport later anyway.
Vs ranged or poke lanes where you will lose health; the quest upgrades it with a shield.

skillOrder.notes: OP.GG: Q > W > E max (E W Q at 1-3 varies). Skill Capped and Lolalytics (16.19) prefer W first, then Q, then E. Both are close; Q first gives more heal in lane, W first gives more attack speed. R at 6/11/16.

startingItems.when: Default (61.84% pick on OP.GG, also Lolalytics).
Vs ranged or poke tops where you take chip damage.
Aggressive attack-speed start (Skill Capped) in winnable melee lanes.

firstItemOptions.when: Default first item: on-hit heal is huge with your passive and it melts tanks.
Chase and dive power; pick when you need to catch or fight in the side lanes.
Lolalytics core alternative for extra on-hit damage in duels.

boots.when: Default vs AD and auto-attackers (56.18% pick, 52.50% WR on OP.GG).
Vs heavy CC or AP damage (Skill Capped core build uses it).

firstBackBuys.buy: Recurve Bow - first component of Blade of The Ruined King (on-hit and attack speed for your passive).
Phage - health and the component for Stridebreaker; buy it if you need HP more than damage.

items.name: Blade of The Ruined King
items.why: %HP on-hit damage and lifesteal that stacks with your passive heal.

items.name: Stridebreaker
items.why: Active slow and dash to catch targets; pairs with R and Q.

items.name: Kraken Slayer
items.why: Extra on-hit true damage on every third hit; alternate first item on Lolalytics.

items.name: Death's Dance
items.why: Delays damage and heals you; strong third item.

items.name: Spirit Visage
items.why: MR and bonus healing that boosts your passive and Q.

items.name: Sterak's Gage
items.why: Shield when low, tenacity, health; great with your low-HP style.

items.name: Hullbreaker
items.why: Default 4th item for side-lane split pushing.

items.name: Guardian Angel
items.why: Revive that keeps you in the fight after you dive.

items.name: Jak'Sho, The Protean
items.why: Late-game tank stats and resists for sustained front-line fights.

items.name: Terminus
items.why: On-hit damage and resist shred for long fights against tanks.

items.name: Maw of Malmortius
items.why: MR plus a magic damage shield when you must survive AP burst.

items.name: Force of Nature
items.why: Big MR and move speed against sustained magic damage.

items.name: Thornmail
items.why: Armor plus Grievous Wounds on enemies that hit you.

items.name: Randuin's Omen
items.why: Armor, health and a slow to stop marksmen and assassins.

items.name: Black Cleaver
items.why: Armor shred and health when the enemy stacks armor.

items.name: Mercury's Treads
items.why: Tenacity and MR against CC and magic damage.

powerSpikes.what: Q gives a heal trade; play for short trades and avoid long fights against ranged champions.
Q, W and E together: first real trade window when the enemy wastes a key ability.
R suppress: you can kill a low target or dive with your jungler.

powerSpikes.when: First item (Blade of The Ruined King)
powerSpikes.what: Big spike: on-hit damage and lifesteal turn every fight into a heal-fest, especially below 50% health.
Bonus XP, level cap 20 and a free Teleport: use it for Herald (15:00) and drake fights.

powerSpikes.when: Stridebreaker + Blade of The Ruined King
powerSpikes.what: Catch and kill anyone; you can force fights and split push.

powerSpikes.when: Three items with Death's Dance / Spirit Visage
powerSpikes.what: Very hard to kill: dive backlines and stay in fights.
